_note: Keys starting with underscore are documentation only — the app ignores them.
_note_sectionAccents: Per-section accent colour palette. Swapped in automatically as the user scrolls into each section. Each entry needs: accent (main colour), accentHover (lighter variant for hover states), accentInk (text colour on top of accent — use dark for bright accents, light for dark ones).
_note_sections: Toggle each page section on (true) or off (false). Disabled sections are completely removed from the DOM — no empty space is left behind.
_note_languages: Enable the languages available in the UI. At least one must be true. If only one is enabled the language switcher is hidden automatically. Supported values: 'en' (English), 'it' (Italian).
_note_features: Individual feature flags. Set to true to enable, false to disable. availabilityBadge: shows an 'open to work' pill in the Hero section. contactForm: shows the contact form inside the Contact section (requires a valid Formspree endpoint in Contact.jsx).
_note_splash: Intro splash screen shown before the portfolio loads. enabled: true | false. showOn: 'always' (every visit), 'session' (once per browser session), 'once' (once ever, stored in localStorage). video: path to the splash video inside /public. fallbackMs: milliseconds before the splash is dismissed automatically if the video hasn't ended (safety net). fadeDurationMs: duration of the fade-out transition in milliseconds.
